candidates.text: according to the foreknowledge of God the Cosmic Parent, in sanctification of the Ruach, that you may obey Yeshua the Messiah and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
If you are insulted for the name of Messiah, you are blessed; because the Ruach of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.
and I have filled him with the Ruach of Elohim, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
YHWH has filled him with the Ruach of Elohim, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
The Ruach of YHWH came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and YHWH delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand: and his hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.
But the Ruach of YHWH came on Gid'on; and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered together after him.
Then the Ruach of YHWH came on Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead and Menashe, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over to the children of Ammon.
The Ruach of YHWH began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
The Ruach of YHWH came mightily on him, and he tore him as he would have torn a kid; and he had nothing in his hand: but he didn't tell his father or his mother what he had done.

The Ruach of YHWH came mightily on him, and he went down to Ashqelon, and struck thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave the changes [of clothing] to those who declared the riddle. His anger was kindled, and he went up to his father's house.

When he came to Lehi, the Philistines shouted as they met him: and the Ruach of YHWH came mightily on him, and the ropes that were on his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands dropped from off his hands.

It will happen, as soon as I am gone from you, that the Ruach of YHWH will carry you I don't know where; and so when I come and tell Achav, and he can't find you, he will kill me: but I your servant revere YHWH from my youth.
Shall it be said, O house of Ya'akov: "Is the Ruach of YHWH angry? Are these his doings? Don't my words do good to the one who walks blamelessly?"
But as for me, I am full of power by the Ruach of YHWH, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Ya'akov his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.
When they came there to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Ruach of Elohim came mightily on him, and he prophesied among them.
The Ruach of Elohim came mightily on Shaul when he heard those words, and his anger was kindled greatly.
Then Shmuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brothers: and the Ruach of YHWH came mightily on Dawid from that day forward. So Shmuel rose up, and went to Ramah.
Now the Ruach of YHWH departed from Shaul, and an troubling spirit from YHWH troubled him.
He went there to Naioth in Ramah: and the Ruach of Elohim came on him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

YHWH came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Ruach that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders: and it happened that when the Ruach rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.
Bil'am lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Ruach of Elohim came on him.
YHWH said to Moshe, Take Yehoshua the son of Nun, a person in whom is the Ruach, and lay your hand on him;
which in other generations was not made known to the children of people, as it has now been revealed to his holy emissaries and prophets in the Ruach;

The Ruach of Elohim came on Zekharyah the son of Yehoyada the priest; and he stood above the people, and said to them, Thus says Elohim, Why disobey you the commandments of YHWH, so that you can't prosper? because you have forsaken YHWH, YHWH has also forsaken you.
The Ruach entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard the one who spoke to me.
Then the Ruach lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, [saying], Blessed be the glory of YHWH from his place.
Then the Ruach entered into me, and set me on my feet; and he spoke with me, and said to me, Go, shut yourself within your house.

He put forth the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my head; and the Ruach lifted me up between earth and the sky, and brought me in the visions of Elohim to Yerushalayim, to the door of the gate of the inner [court] that looks toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.
The hand of YHWH was on me, and he brought me out in the Ruach of YHWH, and set me down in the midst of the valley; and it was full of bones.
not by works of righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Ruach of Elohim,

They said to him, See now, there are with your servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray you, and seek your master, lest the Ruach of YHWH has taken him up, and cast him on some mountain, or into some valley. He said, You shall not send.
